life_setup.offer:
Lifekit is on. Here's what we can keep track of together.

• Calendar: tell me your appointments, to-dos and daily routines and I'll put them on your Google Calendar. I'll keep track of who you meet, where, and the travel time, and open and close each day with a morning brief and a daily retro
• Meals, workouts & InBody: log what you ate, how you trained, and your body records

Which would you like to try first?
onboard.defer.nudge: You put off setting your goal until today. Want to pick it up now? Say "let's do onboarding" and we'll continue where we left off.
life_setup.calendar.connect:
Great, let's start with your calendar.

If you connect Google Calendar, everything I sort out shows up on your phone's calendar too. You can start right away without connecting; when you connect later, everything you added in the meantime goes up as well.

If you're at your Mac, you can connect right now. The sign-in window opens on the Mac screen and it takes about a minute.
life_setup.calendar.first_input:
Tell me what's on this week: appointments, things you need to do, routines you do every day. Several at once is fine.

e.g. dinner with Minsu in Gangnam Friday at 7pm
• report due Friday
• stretching every morning at 7
life_setup.calendar.connect_later: For Google Calendar, just say "connect calendar" when you're at your Mac.
life_setup.tell.both:
I'll sum up these appointments and to-dos in a morning brief every day, and at night we'll look back on the day together in the daily retro.

The brief goes out at {morning} and the retro at {retro}. If another time suits you better, just tell me.
life_setup.tell.morning:
I'll sum up these appointments and to-dos in a morning brief every day.

It goes out at {morning}. If another time suits you better, just tell me.
life_setup.tell.retro:
At night we'll look back on the day together in the daily retro.

It goes out at {retro}. If another time suits you better, just tell me.
life_setup.health.prompt:
Great, let's start with meals, workouts & InBody.

Send me what you ate, how you trained, and your body records, in words or as a photo.
• Meals: "kimchi stew and rice for lunch" or a photo of the food -> I estimate the calories and protein and log it
• Workouts: "bench press 60kg 10 reps x 3 sets", "30-minute run" -> I log the exercise and sets
• InBody: one photo of the result sheet -> I read and save weight, skeletal muscle and body fat

Want to send one thing you ate today to start?
life_setup.closing.offer_health: If you'd like to try meals, workouts & InBody too -- logging what you ate, how you trained and your body records -- just say "let's log meals" any time.
life_setup.closing.offer_calendar: If you'd like to try the calendar too -- sorting out your appointments and to-dos -- just say "let's try the calendar" any time.

e.g. office, near Pangyo station

travel.presence.offer:
If you're at {place} on set days and hours, tell me. Once that's registered, I'll work out where you leave from for your next appointments without asking.

e.g. Mon-Fri 9am-6pm

meal.target.ask:
I'll work out your daily target. Tell me these five at once.

e.g. 175cm, 72kg, 34, male, want to lose a little
• height, weight
• age, sex
• direction: lose / keep / gain

A photo of an InBody result sheet works too. I'll read weight and body fat from it for a more accurate target.
